title: MowzVP
description: A PvP texture pack that is simple but affective!
body:
This is a PvP resource pack that is simplistic but easy to use.

This resource pack is focused on simplistic style which is optimized for beign able to focus on PvP and not the hud.

This includes things like; a G on golden apples, enchantment glint more obvious on armour, shorter swords, blue hotbar _(Because according to Google AI it is the colour that draws the eye the least)_ and so on.
